tasks.story: Build LO pre-approval parameters form with RBAC-protected submission capturing borrower financials, property details, and loan terms
acceptance: Form captures income, assets, liabilities, credit score estimate, DTI
Property address, purchase price, down payment, loan type inputs present
Submit button creates PreApproval record with user_id, timestamps
RBAC: Only authenticated LO or admin roles can access
Form validation enforces required fields and numeric constraints

tasks.story: Create PreApproval model with audit fields and relationship to User and LoanEstimate
acceptance: PreApproval model with borrower_name, income, assets, liabilities, credit_score fields
Foreign keys to User and optional LoanEstimate
status field (draft, submitted, approved, denied) with default draft
created_at, updated_at, submitted_at, approved_at timestamp fields
Migration applied and tested with sample records

tasks.story: Implement pre-approval letter generation with merge variables and PDF export with watermark
acceptance: Template stored in database or file with merge vars (borrower_name, max_loan_amount, expiration_date)
Endpoint accepts PreApproval ID and returns populated HTML or PDF
PDF export adds 'Draft' or 'Official' watermark based on status
Audit event logged on letter generation with user_id and timestamp
Letter includes ECOA/CFPB disclaimer text

tasks.story: Design pricing adapter plug-in interface with 3 rails logic (price, points, credit) and mock investor bot/API
acceptance: Abstract PricingAdapter base class with get_pricing(loan_params) method
Mock investor adapter returns 3 scenarios with rate, points, lender_credit
Adapter returns structured JSON with loan_amount, rate, apr, monthly_payment
Unit tests verify adapter interface and mock data structure
Documentation includes adapter contract and extension guide

tasks.story: Build fee engine wiring to jurisdiction DB for taxes, transfer, recordation, title, prepaids, escrows, UFMIP, MIP, VAFF calculations
acceptance: FeeEngine service queries TaxData by county and applies property tax, transfer tax, recordation tax
Title insurance calculated based on loan amount and property value
Prepaids include property tax proration, insurance, interest
UFMIP (FHA upfront) and MIP (monthly) calculated when loan_type is FHA
VAFF (VA funding fee) calculated when loan_type is VA
Source badges (system, AI, override) tracked in calculation metadata
JSON trace returned with fee breakdown for audit

tasks.story: Build 3 scenario comparison cards with PITIA, DTI, LTV, Cash to Close, and expandable LE-style cost sections (A,B,C,E,H)
acceptance: 3 cards displayed side-by-side with scenario name, rate, points, lender credit
Each card shows PITIA breakdown, DTI ratio, LTV ratio, Cash to Close
Expand/collapse for Section A (Loan Terms), B (Projected Payments), C (Closing Costs), E (Taxes), H (Other)
Cards highlight differences (rate, points, credit) between scenarios
Visual design uses MUI Card, Typography, Chip components

tasks.story: Implement scenario comparison PDF export with watermark and LE-style formatting
acceptance: Export button generates PDF with all 3 scenarios
PDF includes borrower name, property address, date, scenario details
Watermark reads 'For Comparison Purposes Only - Not a Loan Estimate'
PDF formatted to resemble CFPB LE layout (sections A-H)
Endpoint returns PDF blob for download

tasks.story: Enforce RBAC permissions for pre-approval submission and letter generation endpoints
acceptance: Endpoint permissions restrict access to authenticated users with LO or admin role
User can only view/edit their own pre-approvals unless admin
Admin can view all pre-approvals and update status
Unauthorized access returns 403 Forbidden with message
Unit tests verify permission enforcement

tasks.story: Build API endpoint to generate 3 scenarios given loan parameters and return structured comparison data
acceptance: POST /api/scenarios/ accepts loan_amount, property_value, credit_score, loan_type
Endpoint calls PricingAdapter and FeeEngine to build 3 scenarios
Response includes scenario array with rate, points, credit, PITIA, DTI, LTV, cash_to_close
Each scenario includes detailed fee breakdown in JSON
Endpoint logs audit event with user_id and scenario parameters

tasks.story: Write unit tests for FeeEngine with mocked jurisdiction data covering FHA, VA, conventional loan types
acceptance: Tests verify property tax calculation with composite rate
Tests verify transfer tax buyer/seller split logic
Tests verify UFMIP calculation for FHA loans
Tests verify VAFF calculation for VA loans
Tests verify deterministic output given same inputs
All tests pass in CI pipeline
